ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels covering approximately 85% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) mottle and localized clusters accounting for approximately 15% of the pixel area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity mottle located in the inner-medial quadrant of the left lobe; smaller high-intensity clusters concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes; multiple discrete circular ring-shaped features distributed across the medial regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 65 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio within its bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations range from 5 to 25 pixels, with the most pronounced jagged peaks occurring on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve originating from the median notch and extending toward the posterior-distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular, high-contrast ring-shaped pixel clusters (5-12 pixel diameter) primarily on the left lobe and lower-medial right lobe, indicative of barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, near-parallel diagonal linear marks (rake marks) on the mid-to-upper right lobe; one distinct vertical linear disruption on the inner left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant calcified biological masses (barnacle colonization) observed at the distal tips of both lobes; extensive irregular pigmentation loss/scarring on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly defined circular 'donut' scars and extreme irregular encrustation on the terminal margins of the fluke lobes.
